items.title: AI just solved something no human can understand
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and an internal version of Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem, in 17 million lines of code that computers have checked and no human can follow. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what the hypothesis says, the human proof that arrived the same day and what people are for when AI makes discoveries nobody understands.
